rules.command_shape: Sit / Down: reach within 3 s, then hold 0.6 s; other commands: hold the target duration (settle grace 2 s)
rules.reach_time: first raw target frame of the confirmed run
rules.break_at_s: first frame after the last raw target frame

steps.app_numbers_hold: state_machine.py rules and app numbers, every command a hold of the stated duration
steps.app: the app: Sit / Down reach-then-hold, others hold
